ui.voce_sub: All spoken, voice commands: you don't need the screen.
ui.occhi_sub: Map, cards and walks to look at.
ui.libera_sub: Go where you like: I'll tell you what you pass, as you pass it.
ui.percorso_sub: A ready-made itinerary, start to finish.
ui.torna_sub: Picking up where you left off: voice guide, all spoken.
ui.installa: Add the icon to your phone
ui.attesa: Finding out where you are. Then I'll tell you what's around you.

frasi.come-cammini: Do you want to walk freely, or follow a route?
frasi.parto-libero: I'll start with the free walk. Say routes whenever you like.
frasi.bentornato: Voice guide on. I'll tell you what you pass, which side and how many metres.
frasi.voce-attiva: Voice mode on. I'll announce every place you pass, which side and how far.
frasi.aiuto: You can say: tell me more, next, repeat, where am I, or stop.
frasi.chiedi: Shall I tell you more, or move on?
frasi.niente-intorno: There's nothing around here to tell you about.
frasi.cerco: Looking for the address, one moment.
frasi.non-capito: I didn't catch that. Try: tell me more, next, where am I.
frasi.apro-taxi: Opening the taxi with your position. You confirm the ride.
frasi.nessun-numero: I have no number to call: it has to be saved first.
frasi.casa-segnata: Home set here. When you want to go back, say: take me home.
frasi.casa-non-segnata: I don't know where home is. When you're there, tap Set home here.
frasi.casa-senza-posizione: First I need to know where you are: press Start.
frasi.vengo-a-prenderti: I'm preparing the message: tap Send to send it. Or say: call.
frasi.niente-partenza: I haven't marked a starting point.
frasi.solo-cultura: All right: I'll only tell you the places worth seeing.
frasi.tutto: All right: I'll tell you everything, shops and stops too.
frasi.niente-microfono: This phone doesn't understand voice commands.
